d: Long, wavy platinum blonde hair with a side part and long bangs frames a mature face with a calm expression and sharp, emerald green eyes. The build is slender and tall, dressed in a white high-collared dress with a black pleated underskirt and white tights, all layered under a voluminous, floor-length deep red cloak. Gold jewelry with green gemstones adorns the chest and waist, and a black folder is held in the hands, completed by black heeled shoes.
